item.description:

There are near misses almost every day because of this, and it’s only a matter of time before someone has an accident. Please can the lines be repainted urgently before someone gets hurt? Thanks.

item.title: Repeated Fly-Tipping – Request for Permanent Preventative Action, 7th October
item.description:
Am writing to report an ongoing problem with repeated fly-tipping. This issue has been happening repeatedly and has been reported on previous occasions. The council removes the dumped rubbish, but unfortunately, within a few days, more rubbish is dumped in exactly the same area. While I appreciate the rubbish being collected, simply removing it is not resolving the underlying problem. The location appears to have become a regular dumping spot, and this is causing an ongoing nuisance for local residents. I have attached recent photographs showing the latest rubbish that has been left there. Could the council please investigate a more permanent preventative solution? For example, I would ask you to consider fencing or otherwise securing access to the area, installing CCTV/a monitoring camera, or taking other appropriate measures to deter repeated fly-tipping. I would also appreciate it if this could be treated as an ongoing fly-tipping problem rather than simply another individual collection request. Please could you confirm what action can be taken to prevent this from continuing and whether the site can be assessed for suitable preventative measures?

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Belgrave Street, Broadfield, Heywood, Rochdale
Report on FixMyStreet
